The '''Gen'Dai vault''' was one of many [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vaults that were uncovered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the construction of [[Belsavis prison]]. The vault was used by the Republic to incarcerate inmates of the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Species/Legends|species]], though they escaped during the [[Invasion of Belsavis|battle]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Perfect Carrier">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Perfect Carrier|Belsavis}}</ref>
